description: One row per person, visit and test battery the person was scheduled for (pre_old, trained, novel, atomic, validity), including missed and pending visits. Holds denominators, completeness and timing, never scores: an endpoint value is computed by #34 only when status is complete (a partial battery stays in supporting analyses). Producer #33; consumers #34. Unique key: visit_id, battery. CSV encoding and masking rules: analysis/docs/architecture.md and docs/interfaces/analysis.md.

accounted_n.description: Opportunities with a trial-log row (played or technical failure); excludes opportunities not undertaken after withdrawal.

book_id.description: Study A anonymous book ID from the learner-facing slot list (no method meaning); Study B bank ID. Methods are joined by #34 from the restricted key at unmasking.

data_kind.description: Watermark: SYNTHETIC or REAL, equal to the data root's.

days_since_anchor.description: Calendar days from the anchor visit.

fault_n.description: Accounted opportunities with a technical fault.

missing_reason.description: Why the battery is partial or missing.

person_id.description: Person slot (A-C07-L03, B-C12-M1). Coded participant IDs and the slot binding stay in the reveal log; no names or contact data anywhere.

planned_endpoint.description: Complete and in window (or an anchor visit): the planned endpoint is available.

status.description: complete: accounted_n = scheduled_n; partial: 0 < accounted_n < scheduled_n; missing: none accounted.

unit_id.description: Study A matched batch or Study B dyad slot (A-C07, B-C12).

visit.description: Visit (A D0, D7; B V1, V2, V3, W1, W4).

visit_date.description: Local study date of the visit (run sheet), when held.

visit_seq.description: 1-based order of the visit within its study.

window_hi_days.description: Last allowed day after the anchor.

window_lo_days.description: First allowed day after the anchor.

title: Per-person endpoint availability table row (derived/endpoints.csv)
